one_month_reasoning: Scheduled events in the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-29 window: the Oct 28-29 FOMC, where Kalshi/Polymarket price roughly a 66-69% chance of a second consecutive 25bp hike (as of Sep 29, per PredictionNews; volume not reachable, page blocked fetch) - largely priced but a hawkish surprise hit ON 9% on Sep 16 alongside the analyst day. onsemi's Q3 report is estimated for ~Nov 2 (not yet confirmed), i.e. most likely just outside the window, though a pre-announcement or earlier date is possible; Q3 guide was $1.65-1.75B / $0.81-0.93 EPS and Q2 beat the midpoint. Peer Q3 reports (TXN, NXPI, STM, MCHP-type analog/auto names) in late October will move the group. Short-horizon regularities are mixed: strongly negative 3-month momentum (down ~44% from the June 3 high) vs a +14% bounce off the Sep 16 low. No clear directional edge, so I center at ~$76 with ~16% monthly sigma (a bit below 64%/3.5 = 18% because the realized figure is inflated by two one-off event days).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (horizon NTM EPS ~$4.50 x 17x = $76.5, weight 0.5), 2027 EPS on consensus haircut ($4.10 x 19x = $78, weight 0.25) and FCF yield (~$4.80/share 2027 FCF at 5.5% = $87, weight 0.25) -> ~$80.

inputs_detail.derivation: 2027 consensus ~$4.53 (BofA $4.57); NTM at Sep-2027 blends 2027/2028 (~$5.0 standalone) and I haircut ~10% for a Fed hiking cycle and Synaptics dilution (~13.5% more shares, offset partly by $200M synergies).

ON 10-yr median trailing P/E ~22x (GuruFocus); BofA now uses 20x 2028 EPS; I apply a discount to that for stock-merger integration risk and rising rates; 17x is mid-cycle forward for analog/power peers.
Consensus ~$4.53 cut ~10%: Q3 guide midpoint $0.87 and Q2 $0.74 imply 2026 ~$3.20; reaching $4.53 requires ~40% growth, consensus in cyclical recoveries under rate hikes historically overshoots.
Slight premium to the NTM multiple because it is on a nearer-year EPS; below BofA's former 32x and near ON's long-run median.
Q2 2026 FCF $425M (27% FCF margin) annualizes ~$1.7B; modest growth with revenue +10%.
Rates rising (Fed hiked Sep 16, further hikes priced), so a higher-than-2021-era yield; cyclical semis with 5%+ FCF yield usually trough-to-mid valuations.

bear.story: Fed keeps hiking into a slowdown, auto/industrial recovery stalls, Synaptics integration and dilution weigh (stock-financed acquirers underperform on average), EPS ~$3.5 at ~13-14x; revisits 2025 lows.

base.story: Recovery continues (AI data center >$500M in 2026, utilization up), EPS ~$4.1-4.5, multiple stays ~17-19x while the market waits for the 2028+ payoff; Synaptics closes mid-2027.

bull.story: Cycle upturn plus AI power wins re-rate ON back toward 24-25x on ~$5 NTM EPS; rates peak; stock recovers most of the post-deal gap toward the June high of $134.92.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$50 the stock would trade at ~11-12x 2027 consensus EPS and ~10% FCF yield, levels ON only reached near the 2025 cycle trough; getting there would most likely require a real guidance cut (demand relapse in auto/industrial, SiC pricing collapse) or a failed/renegotiated Synaptics deal, not ordinary volatility.

Whether 2027 consensus EPS (~$4.53) is achievable in a hiking environment

AI data center power ramp pace vs SiC/EV competition from Chinese suppliers
reasoning: Base-rate anchoring: ON is a high-beta cyclical (64% realized vol, 10-yr trailing P/E range 6x-200x, median ~22x) that has already fallen ~44% from its June 3 high of $134.92 on two events: a 24% one-day drop on the $6.7-7B all-stock Synaptics deal (Jun 25) and a 9% drop on the Sep 16 analyst day coinciding with a Fed hike. Its previous 2023-2025 drawdown was ~-40% from ~$100 and bottomed when expectations reset. Academic evidence (Loughran-Vijh 1997; Savor-Lu 2009) finds stock-financed acquirers earn negative long-run abnormal returns on average, a mild drag; prediction markets price a ~2/3 chance of another hike in October, a headwind for long-duration growth multiples. Against this, fundamentals are improving: Q2 revenue +9% y/y, non-GAAP GM 39.3% rising to 40-42% guided, FCF margin 27%, net debt only ~$0.6B (cash+STI $3.86B vs debt $4.46B), and sell-side mean target ~$104 (range $75-150). My blended fair value ~$80 is only slightly above spot, so I center the 12-month distribution at a ~$78 median with ~52% lognormal sigma (below the event-inflated 64% realized, above a typical large cap), giving P(>=76) ~0.52 and a meaningful 25% bear mass near $48 and 25% bull mass near $120. Research was limited: onsemi IR site returned 503 (used SEC 8-K instead), several news and prediction-market pages blocked fetch, Twelve Data fundamentals were plan-restricted.
